question: For which discovery was Paul Ehrlich awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine in 1908?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Theoretical basis for immunology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Paul Ehrlich** was awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine in **1908** for his pioneering work in the field of **immunology**.
 
• He developed the **side-chain theory**, which explained how antitoxins (antibodies) are produced by the body to neutralize toxins.
